title: Entering Year 4 as Packers starter, Jordan Love has adopted a habit he learned from Aaron Rodgers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Entering Year 4 as Packers starter, Jordan Love has adopted a habit he learned from Aaron Rodgers
sources.description: “This probably happens to a lot of quarterbacks [where] they almost get to like where their knowledge is that of a coach,” Packers general manager Brian Gutekunst said of Love.
